synthetic_data_disclaimer: This demo uses synthetic, rule-driven datasets to simulate farm, weather, soil, and market conditions because complete real field datasets are not yet available. Recommendations are for proof-of-concept and system demonstration, not final agronomic advisory.
real_data_roadmap: Integrate real weather feeds per sub-county and store daily observations.
Ingest verified market price logs from market centers.
Capture farmer-reported and extension-verified yield outcomes each season.
Add soil lab samples (pH/NPK/organic carbon) at ward/sub-county level.
Retrain model each season, compare against baseline, and publish updated metrics.
